pages.title: Wheat, Hop & Potato
pages.text: Start with water in the tub for each recipe.$(br2)$(li)7 wheat → wheat wort$(li)5 wheat + 2 hop cones → beer wort$(li)7 potatoes → potato wort

pages.title: Fruit & Sugar Cane
pages.text: $(li)8 wine grapes → grape juice$(li)8 apples → apple juice$(li)7 sugar cane → sugar-cane wort$(li)7 tomatoes → tomato juice

pages.title: Agave, Honey & Juniper
pages.text: $(li)7 agave leaves → agave juice$(li)8 honeycombs or honey bottles → honey wort$(li)4 juniper berries + sugar + 2 grapes + wheat → juniper wort

pages.title: Pack Ingredients
pages.text: These recipes need items supplied by the corresponding common item tags. Check your pack’s recipe viewer.$(br2)$(li)7 corn → corn wort$(li)7 rice → rice wort$(li)8 bananas → banana mash$(li)8 pineapples → pineapple mash

pages.title: More Fluid Families
pages.text: Transfer milk from a milk bucket. Ferment it into blaand or distill it into arkhi. Kava is a separate registered drink fluid with no stock crop or mash recipe. Check pack-provided sources for fluids without stock recipes.
